networkPolicy.desc: Facebook is blocked; maps and points of interest stay open

notes: Written from the binary and from the tunnel. It is a Flutter application with Mapbox and MapLibre maps; on launch it reached a.amudanan.co.il only. Its own hosts are amudanan.co.il and its a., b., c., api., download. and purchase. subdomains, plus map tiles from api.mapbox.com, api.maptiler.com and tile.thunderforest.com. Blocked: the Facebook SDK (app events and login). The Google ad hosts are listed for app builds that predate globalBlockedHosts; no AdMob ad unit was found.
